title: tc-enrichment-grid
description: A table a model fills in, cell by cell, with the run's progress, Pause / Resume and Retry failed.

description.description: A line under the heading – what's being enriched

columns.description: The columns, in order – source columns and AI columns

rows.description: The rows – source text and AI cells by column id

running.description: Whether the run is going. Changed by Pause and Resume unless a tc-run-change listener calls preventDefault()

remaining.description: Time left in the run, in ms – the header says "~4 min left"

selected.description: The picked cell (null: none). Changed by picking a cell unless a tc-cell-select listener calls preventDefault()

threshold.description: Confidence below this (0–1) is called low

locale.description: The locale for the counts and percentages

ai.description: Filled by a model – marked with a sparkle, its cells carry a state

prompt.description: The prompt that fills an AI column – shown on its header

EnrichmentColumn.description: A column: a source column the page has, or an AI column a prompt fills

EnrichmentRow.description: A row: the source columns' text, and each AI column's cell (missing: queued)

value.description: What the model wrote – shown when done or under review

confidence.description: How sure the model was, 0 to 1

source.description: Where the value came from – a link on the cell

note.description: What went wrong, for a failed cell; why to look, for one under review
